# v1.0.2 · Exit means exit

### Fixed

- **Exit actually exits.** It used to hide the tray icon but keep TrackDeck running in the background, which also stopped you from starting it again.
- **Your animation comes back.** Exit and **Restore my screen** put back whatever you had selected, GIFs included, instead of a still image.
- **Starting it twice** now tells you TrackDeck is already running (look under the ^ arrow in the tray).

### New

- `TrackDeck screens` lists the images and GIFs stored on the keyboard, and `TrackDeck select <id>` shows one of them. Handy if the wrong screen ever comes back.

**Full changelog:** [v1.0.1...v1.0.2](https://github.com/yourgirljolyne/TrackDeck/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2)
